about: Slope workout by distance (hill repeats, power aim, cadence target) over FTMS with shifting in Rodillo, a 2x drivetrain, a trainer whose real gear and mass differ from the settings, uneven pedalling, a bike and gearing change mid-ride, coasting and an auto pause

workout.name: Hill repeats 5 x 1.5 km at 6%
workout.description: Distance-based climbs: each rep ends at the top, not on a timer, so a stronger effort finishes sooner. Aim for ~105% FTP, seated, 75-85 rpm, and shift to keep cadence. Recover on 2 km of flat between reps.
